Some of my class policies can be found [here](policies/index.qmd). 

Below is a list of courses I am teaching/have taught in the past.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
past_courses <- read.csv("courses.csv")
table <- kbl(past_courses,
    col.names = c("Year", "Term", "Institution", "ID", "Name", "Role", "Notes"), 
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = rep("l", ncol(past_courses)),
    longtable = TRUE,
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),full_width = F)

table
```
